object.Title: Saint Francis of Assisi

object.Description:
For more information on this painting, please see Federico Zeri's 1976 catalogue no. 262, p. 388.

For the latest information about this object, Saint Francis of Assisi, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: Don Marcello Massarenti Collection, Rome [date and mode of acquisition unknown] [1881 catalogue: no. 195; 1897 catalogue: no. 184, as Annibale Carracci]; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1902, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
